title: Experimental dataset to assess the structural performance of cracked reinforced concrete using Digital Image Correlation techniques with fixed and moving cameras
authors: Andreas Sjölander; Valeria Belloni; Viktor Peterson; Jonatan Ledin
specific_gap: Does the paper establish that each exact next included IB nominal load for the eight historical forecast queries was known at its prediction origin?
summary: [论文原文]发布三根预裂钢筋混凝土梁的固定/移动相机图像和三点弯曲机测数据，供比较DIC/CMfM及结构模型。
research_question: [论文原文]为裂缝图像测量与预裂梁结构模型提供可复用实验数据（Abstract;§2）。本论文并未以起点信息集明确的预测评估为研究目标。
method: [论文原文]位移控制加载；25Hz力/活塞位移记录；在预设荷载停点拍照；四台固定相机与非固定手机，时钟/开始时刻供事后对齐（Specifications Table;§2–4）。
data_setting: [论文原文]梁4/5/6；每梁四个固定区域及移动视角；参考尺图；加载和拍摄表。当前D01用IB固定Canon区域。
main_result: [论文原文]主要贡献是数据和采集设计，而非本文所问的前瞻预测性能；未提供八次查询各自在起点冻结的精确目标信息记录（Abstract;§2–4）。
positive_evaluation: [分析判断]1.图像与机测数据并存，能区分图像观测和加载状态。2.固定/移动相机与参考尺设计，支持检查视角依赖和图像测量可重复性。两者符合数据论文用途，但不自动建立预测信息集。
positive_evidence: Specifications Table;§3 folder descriptions and ruler images;§4 data collection setup;Figs3,7 captions
negative_evaluation: [论文原文]Limitations节写None。[分析判断]本文对本次用途的限制是：没有逐梁精确提前计划/变更记录及下一纳入IB观测的在线选择规则；手工时间对齐未报告量化不确定性。[未明确给出]不能把这些当作作者根本没有计划。
limitation_evidence: §3 Test Data/Filtered Data说明事后时钟对齐；§2只说明预设停载；全文无逐8查询起点信息表。单独mmc1.pdf访问挑战，未读，不能作所有材料穷尽性缺失结论。
neutral_implication: [分析判断]可保留下一名义荷载作为明确给定情景的条件输入；历史八查询仍为回顾性荷载条件开发。若评估自然下一观测，应另定只读历史输入的规则，不把未来实测力当起点输入。
gap_dimensions: Supports predefined load-stop protocol, not demonstrated exact historical origin-availability predicate for all eight retained observations
gap_rationale: ⑤预设加载协议这个较弱前提被支持；精确下一名义目标/纳入观测在各起点已知这一更强前提，当前访问范围证据不足。不是证明其未知，也不是预测路线失效。
gap_evidence: Abstract/Specifications Table/§2;§3;§4。外部核对：三采集表具体单元格见load_knowledge.json；G4 Beam-time!A18=20且拍摄时间空，提示计划行不等于实际下一纳入观测。
code_data_availability: Mendeley Data10.17632/z3yc9z84tk.3 in paper;v4 current inspected release10.17632/z3yc9z84tk.4 (canonical page says added paper link). No v3/v4 byte identity assumed. [未明确给出]本文自身无本次预测代码。
reproducibility_risk: Full MAIN-ARTICLE text locally retained and read in this turn, identity checked against canonical PMC metadata. Original Jina extraction lacked header/Specifications Table, explicitly supplemented by canonical web-reader transcription. Figure captions retained; pixels not inspected/not decisive. Supplementary PDF inaccessible and not inspected. Complete local text does not mean complete supplement coverage.
next_action: Retain optical half-depth target and old scores; compare internal position-check capability with pair-specific finite-grid bounds. Separately specify origin-only next-observation evaluation or explicitly supplied nominal-load scenario.
